bug.evidence: src/polisyos/scientist/policy_design/search.py normalizes parameter.min_value/max_value before preserving None; _normalize_value_like(None) returns 0.0; _derive_bounds then treats both bounds as explicit.

thin_input.evidence: The persisted Trinity bundle carries a tunable numeric default_value='0.1'. The same value yields a valid 0.08..0.12 derived range through the schedule branch.

synthetic_scaffold.evidence: formalize_policy_option_set and MockFormalizerAgent produce a generic tax_subsidy/rate/avg_income scaffold from the verified option, but this scaffold is sufficient to derive a search range if optional bounds remain None.

bad_bounds.evidence: The real CAS Trinity bundle does not contain min_value/max_value for verified_policy_option_rate; bad equal bounds are synthesized inside search-spec construction.

frontier_objective_laundering.evidence: The failed run reaches no policy_frontier_report_ref. Existing frontier report persistence has thin metadata and can emit records from candidate structures without evaluated objective provenance, so P25 remains a repair acceptance constraint.

rationale: Lex is wired and invoked by the real policy-design DAG, so this is not built_not_wired.
The failure occurs before frontier persistence and before downstream governance nodes; downstream skips are blocked_upstream, not independent failures.
The direct CAS-artifact reproduction proves absent bounds are converted to a strict invalid 0.0..0.0 search space.
The ParameterBounds strict lower<upper check is correct; the faulty contract is the optional-bound conversion in the search-spec builder.
The generic verified-policy scaffold is a semantic-quality issue for future frontier authority, but not the immediate lower>=upper cause.

risk_points_after_bounds_repair.evidence: PolicyFrontierReport metadata from the DAG node is only {source: c6c_hierarchical_policy_search}.
ObjectiveStack supplies simulation_metrics/candidate_metadata source labels and fallback policy_value=0.0 when measured inputs are absent.
_iter_candidate_records emits feasible=true/objective=0 records when structure candidates exist but no parameter-search records exist.
SearchResult has iterations_completed, stopping_reason, telemetry, and history, but PolicyFrontierReport does not preserve a typed SearchLedger/incompleteness boundary.

required_repair_acceptance: missing min_value/max_value must remain None until _derive_bounds or equivalent typed optional-bound handling
bad explicit equal bounds must still fail closed or be typed as fixed/non-tunable before search
frontier reports must carry search space source, bound derivation, candidate/seed source, objective source refs, stage-b blockers, stopping budget, and non-authority purpose
unevaluated candidates must not be marked feasible in frontier persistence
downstream governance must stay blocked until a valid search result or explicit typed search_blocker artifact exists

route_rows.finding: The policy-design DAG invokes the lex search node and the node fails on a real GY smoke.
The Lex adapter reaches Scientist search spec validation and does not swallow invalid search bounds.
Absent optional bounds are normalized to 0.0 before _derive_bounds, creating a false explicit 0.0..0.0 range.
ParameterBounds correctly rejects strict-invalid lower>=upper ranges.
The formalizer route emits a generic verified_policy_option rate scaffold; this is not the immediate bounds failure, but it is not enough for authoritative frontier semantics.
Current run does not persist a frontier; after bounds repair, frontier persistence needs typed SearchLedger and objective/source provenance before GY-2 can govern downstream.
When no parameter-search records exist, structure candidates can be converted into feasible=true/objective=0 records; this must not be allowed to launder frontier authority.
